conclusion: GGML_METAL=ON alone does not imply unbounded selection or permanent refusal. Refuse unresolved launches; a complete finite possible-load set under frozen build/runtime resolution suffices without predicting the selected winner. GGML_BACKEND_DL default OFF is not observed actual configuration and does not remove the unguarded registry loader functions.
owner_next_evidence: Closed existing CMakeCache.txt plus ggml/Metal compile-definition and backend link rules from compile_commands.json/build.ninja, all hashed as post-execution reconciliation.
Actual values: BUILD_SHARED_LIBS, GGML_BACKEND_DL, GGML_BACKEND_DIR, enabled GGML backend options/available backends, GGML_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS, GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY.

Freeze executable realpath/directory, cwd, compiled backend directory, effective GGML_BACKEND_PATH unset or exact pinned value, and relevant loader environment. Enumerate all possible candidate paths/bytes plus linked-library resolution under that context.

If embedding cannot be established, additionally bound external Metal library/source resources and GGML_METAL_PATH_RESOURCES. Include all variant candidates opened for scoring, not only an expected winner.
No new build/native run/model is needed to copy existing configuration and statically construct the candidate set; unresolved evidence stays a refusal.

owner_question_20260923T145018Z.answer: GGML_BACKEND_PATH is one direct library load target, not a discovery directory. It is processed after ordinary directory searches and is additive; setting it to build/bin does not confine discovery.
owner_question_20260923T145018Z.recommended_preparation: Explicitly unset it or bind a library file and its dependencies; independently bound compiled GGML_BACKEND_DIR (when set), executable directory, cwd and all candidates. Do not confuse the env variable with the directory parameter of ggml_backend_load_all_from_path.
